limitations: This report is an intake preflight; it does not fabricate real CAD or clear the production blocker by itself.
Production credit requires controlled source CAD, cleaned simulation geometry, exact hashes, provenance, and cleanup checks.
The real-CAD blocker remains open until the cleanup package report validates a large-layout non-synthetic manifest.

missing_artifacts.required_action: fill the package manifest from the template with controlled provenance and exact file hashes
stage at least three real source CAD files for a tank/pipe large-layout campaign
stage at least three cleaned simulation geometries derived from the source CAD files
record units, watertightness, degeneracy, positive volume/area, and meter-space bounding boxes per geometry
provide a controlled data-room index with source/cleaned file roles, labels, relative paths, hashes, source type, revision, and owner/supplier
provide cleanup quality records for at least three geometries with true cleanup checks, bbox fields, tool/method, and reviewer
